mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.building_id, b.building_name, b.building_type, r.room_number, r.floor, r.room_type, r.bed_count, r.available_beds, r.major_name, r.class_name, r.class_segment FROM room r LEFT JOIN building b ON r.building_id = b.id WHERE r.building_id = #{buildingId} ORDER BY r.floor ASC, r.room_number ASC

mapper.insert:
